Game Overview

In Ninja Horde Invasion, the core idea is straightforward: quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of Ninja Horde Invasion follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Ninja Horde Invasion?

Ninja Horde Invasion is a free ninja game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Ninja Horde Invasion free to play?

Yes, Ninja Horde Invasion is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
